subject: maths
question: 10 women do half of the total work in 20 days. How many more women will be required to complete the remaining work in 10 days?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply **MDH rule**: Since the **work is equal** (half each), M₁D₁ = M₂D₂.

10 women × 20 days = M₂ women × 10 days

M₂ = 200 ÷ 10 = **20 women**

**Additional women** = 20 − 10 = 10 women.

**∴ The correct answer is 10 women.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Initial women (M₁) = 10, Days (D₁) = 20, Work (W₁) = 1/2. Remaining Work (W₂) = 1/2, Target Days (D₂) = 10.

**Formula Used:** (M₁ × D₁) / W₁ = (M₂ × D₂) / W₂

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ace290d278593654cdbd07caf5a75eca4abc2f6b44726eed7926c106f1e648f.png] 

⇒ (10 × 20) / (1/2) = (M₂ × 10) / (1/2)

⇒ 200 = 10 × M₂

⇒ M₂ = 200 ÷ 10 = 20 women

⇒ **Additional women required** = Total women required − Initial women

⇒ Additional women = 20 − 10 = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10 women.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

General MDH Formula

The relation between Men (M), Days (D), Hours (H) and Work (W) is given by (M₁ × D₁ × H₁) / W₁ = (M₂ × D₂ × H₂) / W₂.

Inverse Proportionality

For a constant amount of work, the number of people is **inversely proportional** to the time taken (M ∝ 1/D). If days are halved, the number of people must be doubled.

Work Efficiency

Total Work = Number of People × Time × Efficiency. If efficiency changes, it is multiplied in the numerator of the MDH formula.</p
